US Congress.title: Congress.gov Notifications Congress.gov Enhancements for November of 2026, Part 2
US Congress.summary: We are pleased to bring you the second installment of Congress.gov enhancements for November of 2026. Enhancement – Days in Session – Improved Functionality Select a shaded day on the Days in Session calendar to see the convene and adjourn times for the legislative day as well as a link to the Congressional Record issue for the selected date. Federal holidays are marked with a dark border.
